title: ritterocactus langsdorfii subsp. multiceps
intro: Ritterocactus langsdorfii subsp. multiceps, commonly known as the "Selenicereus langsdorffii" or "Night-blooming Cereus," is a type of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ritterocactus langsdorfii subsp. multiceps are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
